_about: Per-call figures a correct Codex reader extracts from gen5_incomplete_response.jsonl. Synthetic: ids, paths and numbers are invented. Field names and nesting are taken from the openai/codex source at commit a09812981de703f18f38015cd5d500ab373f616c (1 November 2026): TokenUsage, TokenUsageInfo, TokenCountEvent and TokenUsageRecord in codex-rs/protocol/src/protocol.rs, and the incomplete-response path in codex-rs/core/src/session/mod.rs (record_incomplete_response_usage, TokenUsageContext::SpendingOnly), codex-rs/core/src/session/turn.rs and codex-rs/core/src/compact.rs.
notes: Line 7 follows an incomplete response (line 6 is its token_usage_record): the running total moved by that response, but last_token_usage still holds the response before it (line 5). The call is the total's move, not last_token_usage.
Line 8 repeats line 7's snapshot when rate limits refreshed and must be dropped.
Line 12 is a recomputed context estimate: last_token_usage is zero bar total_tokens and the total is unchanged. It is not a call.
Line 14 follows an incomplete compaction request: the total moved, last_token_usage is still line 12's estimate.
service_tier is absent from thread_settings, as the source writes it when no tier was chosen: standard speed.
